children: Fastenal reported third-quarter 2026 results with net sales of $2.463 billion, up 15.5% year‑over‑year, and net income of $401.6 million, a 19.7% increase versus Q3 2025. Operating income was $530.8 million (21.5% of sales) and diluted net income per share was $0.35. The company generated $421.6 million of operating cash flow in the quarter and returned $328.4 million to shareholders via dividends and buybacks.
Net sales: $2,463.3 million for the three months ended September 30, 2026, up 15.5% year‑over‑year.
Gross profit: $1,104.7 million for the quarter; gross margin 44.8% of net sales.
Operating income: $530.8 million for the quarter; operating margin 21.5% of net sales.
Net income: $401.6 million for the quarter; diluted net income per share $0.35.
Operating cash flow: $421.6 million in the quarter (105% of net income); returned $328.4 million to shareholders (dividends $298.2M; repurchases $30.2M).
Daily sales rate increased 15.5% year‑over‑year, driven by share gains with larger customers, pricing actions, and broad-based demand across core end markets.
Digital and onsite solutions continued to scale: weighted FASTBin/FASTVend signings were 7,484 MEUs in the quarter and installed devices reached 143,878 MEUs at period end.
FMI (FASTStock/FASTBin/FASTVend) sales were $1,121.3 million for the quarter and accounted for 44.8% of sales through the Digital Footprint; FASTBin/FASTVend sales grew 17.6% year‑over‑year.

Customer mix shifted toward larger contract accounts (contract sales were 76.5% of sales), with contract DSR growth of 18.8% versus 13.2% a year earlier, and deeper penetration of manufacturing end markets (total manufacturing 76.6% of sales).
Average active customer Sites totaled 90,759 with growth in higher‑spend Sites ($50k+/mo. Sites increased to 3,288), supporting higher monthly sales per Site among manufacturing customers.
